t: Two billion people on Earth have the exact same death date,
Everyone wakes up one morning with a number above their head.
Everyone sees everyone's, except their own.
People jump off bridges to cheat it.
Then a seven-year-old girl notices one number just changed,
and she did something nobody expected.
and the ending is not what you think.
Watch the full video on my channel,
what if everyone could see their death date?
